cc -O0 -g -o /workspace/tmp/ftab_dbg /workspace/tmp/ftab_dbg.c && python3 - <<'EOF'
import struct, subprocess, os
entries=[(0,64)]
payload = bytearray(struct.pack('<III', 0x31424654, 8, len(entries)))
for addr,length in entries:
    payload += addr.to_bytes(16,'big'); payload.append(length)
env=dict(os.environ); env['DBG']='1'
p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/tmp/ftab_dbg'], input=bytes(payload), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
err=p.stderr.decode()
print(err[:1500])
print('...')
print(err[-1500:])
